mmr.texte: Sleep plays an essential role in learning. During deep sleep, the brain organises the information collected during the day and moves it into long-term memory. Students who sleep less than six hours often have trouble concentrating and remember less of what they study. Experts recommend regular sleep times, a dark room, and avoiding screens for an hour before bed. Caffeine in the afternoon can also delay sleep.

Coastal cities face growing risks from rising sea levels. Governments are responding in different ways. Some build higher walls along the shore, while others restore wetlands, which absorb water naturally. A few cities have decided to move buildings away from the most dangerous areas. Each approach has costs, and experts say the best choice depends on the local landscape and budget.

sst.t: Many cities now offer bicycles for rent in their centres. Users unlock a bike with their phone, ride to their destination and leave it at any station. This system reduces traffic and pollution, and it is cheaper than owning a bicycle. However, some residents complain that stations take too much space on the pavements, and that bicycles are sometimes left in the wrong places. City officials say they will add more stations and rules to solve these problems.

swt.texte: Over the past century, global life expectancy has risen dramatically, mainly because of improvements in sanitation, vaccination and nutrition. At the same time, birth rates have fallen in many countries. As a result, populations in several regions are ageing rapidly, which puts pressure on pension systems and healthcare. Governments are therefore debating whether to raise the retirement age or encourage immigration to balance the workforce.
